It is very difficult to completely eliminate well learned behaviors.

Spontaneous recovery is the reappearance of a conditioned response after a rest period following extinction.

During the period of extinction, no reinforcement has been given at all.�Those conditions make it amazing that a spontaneous recovery of the response suddenly takes place out of the blue.

�

For example, take the previous situation with the cat and the can opener.�Your cat has heard the can opener fifty times without food, and she no longer reacts to the can opener as if she expects food. Behavior extinction has occurred.

One day the can opener is used and she suddenly meows for food, even though the can opener has been used many times without food for her.�Her meowing indicates spontaneous recovery because the link in her mind between food and the electric can opener has been revived.�
